description: Horizon Outpost is a space exploration and technology team focused on developing creative, interactive solutions inspired by lunar exploration and future space missions. Our interests include mission planning, rover navigation, lunar habitats, resource management, data analysis, and educational simulations.
summary:
Horizon Outpost: Lunar Outpost Alpha is an interactive lunar mission simulation game developed by Jacqualine Pruett and Isabella Sherwin. The project challenges players to manage a simulated Moon habitat while balancing limited resources, crew safety, scientific objectives, and unexpected emergencies.

Players control six interconnected power systems while monitoring oxygen, water, food, battery reserves, radiation, and crew health. The game includes nine outpost modules, rover exploration, scientific missions, emergency decision-making, and AURA, an automated warning system that helps players identify developing problems.

Our goal is to make space mission planning engaging and educational by demonstrating how resource management, engineering decisions, and teamwork affect the success of a lunar mission. Horizon Outpost allows players to experiment with these challenges in a virtual environment inspired by real-world space exploration.
details:
Horizon Outpost — Lunar Outpost Alpha

Developers: Jacqualine Pruett (Lead Developer) and Isabella Sherwin (Developer)

Project Overview

Horizon Outpost is an interactive educational lunar survival simulation designed to help players understand the challenges of planning and operating a habitat on the Moon.

Our project was developed in response to the Space Mission Design Game challenge. Instead of simply reading about space exploration, players experience how their decisions affect a simulated lunar mission.

How the Game Works

Players take responsibility for operating a lunar outpost. They must manage six interconnected power allocations while monitoring oxygen, water, food, battery reserves, radiation exposure, and crew health.

The game includes nine outpost modules, an interactive mission briefing, rover exploration, science objectives, emergency scenarios, mission logs, and performance scoring.

AURA, the game's automated assistance system, provides warnings when resources become dangerously low or other mission problems arise.

Players must make strategic decisions to keep the crew safe and complete their mission objectives.

Technology and Development

Horizon Outpost was developed using Base44, with web-based game components and simulation logic. GitHub was used for source-code management and project backup.

AI-assisted development tools, including ChatGPT and Base44, helped support programming, troubleshooting, planning, and development. The project was directed and tested by our team.

Educational Benefits

Our goal is to make space exploration, engineering, and resource management accessible to students and people interested in STEM.

The simulation demonstrates the importance of balancing competing priorities and understanding the consequences of engineering decisions.

Creativity and Innovation

Horizon Outpost combines a resource-management simulation with interactive educational gameplay. Rather than presenting isolated space facts, it challenges players to make connected decisions that influence the outcome of a lunar mission.

The project is an independent educational creation inspired by space exploration. It is not affiliated with, sponsored, approved, or endorsed by NASA.
